Tenebris Somnia Demo v0.4

Combat:

 Faster wrench attack
 Revolver does more damage
 Revolver attacks faster
 Added random knockback to the revolver and based on distance

Enemies

 Ranged attack slowed down, now only occurs after being knocked back
 New close range attack with less damage
 Added quick close range attack with less damage when Julia moves around too much
 Removed impact sound when Julia is blinking
 Enemy noises pause when the game pauses

Cinematics

 Added new cinematic showing the character Iván
 All cinematics have had visuals and audio improved, some of them have new shots

Interactions

 You can interact only if you're facing the object
 General areas improved
 Item Labendoleum now gives you less sanity

Interface

 Added names of characters when they talk, also colored the frames
 Lot of adjustments to the text, both in English and Spanish
 Little fixes and and improvements to the menus and inventory
 Interface health portrait with more sanity states
 Language option removed from the in-game menu

Environments

 Changed Ivan picture on the second floor
 Added some new interactions to the environments
 Visual improvements to some of the rooms
 The TV from the second floor now has constant noise to be clear you need to do something there
 Adjusted the camera so you can see more of the game

Thank you for your continued support of Tenebris Somnia!

notes.title: NEW DEMO, NEW TRAILER, NEW BLOOD 🩸
notes.content:
A scary Halloween for Tenebris Somnia approaches! 🎃 

During 2024 we have been doing dozens of filming sessions and making intense progress with the development of the game. But not only that, we expanded our film crew and also made new partners...


THE UNHOLY ALLIANCE

One of the most important publishers of indie games during the last decade will now be in charge of distributing our title. We are talking about New Blood Interactive, the guys behind great hits like DUSK, AMID EVIL, Gloomwood, Fallen Aces and ULTRAKILL.

But that's not all... Airdorf, the creator of the terrifying FAITH: The Unholy Trinity, will now serve as the Executive Producer of Tenebris Somnia! MORTIS ✝

[previewyoutube=UuvcepjC_dg;full][NEW BLOOD AND AIRDORF LOGOS][/previewyoutube]

THE CINEMATICS

Last month we had our biggest filming sessions to date. We built our own set inside a huge warehouse. It was a full week of shooting with more than thirty film specialists involved, including actors, technicians and production staff 🎥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/3ff23d49a522f0dbd1feb3251008264d3f1559ab.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/42e07c3d312722ff46ceb5f500b5e1b1afdea693.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/be61d8dd665f3ea263be5ce2b7abd71378e6d34c.jpg
We also had other film sessions at the beginning and middle of the year. With everything done to date, we could say that we have already filmed more than 60% of the game's story so far.


THE GAME

Game development also continues progressing strongly. New scenarios, enemies, items and weapons are already part of the current game 🕹️

That’s why we decided to expand the playable demo so that you can taste a little more of what is coming in the final release, which we hope to achieve by the end of 2025.

And here are a couple of new screenshots:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/73b0d13d21f8503016bd04307b8b6f13d98a2606.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/0df8834506ddfa9a3f20f632234eb76276e4eb9b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/f450c07a19967eedfd2f99911fca2dc5944c78f4.jpg

But this is still only a small part of what is to come…

Incredible things continue to happen in the development of Tenebris Somnia, although we can't reveal more for now, we hope you enjoy the new demo and don't forget to tell us about it, what you liked and what you think we could improve on 🙌

Follow us on the game's official networks on Twitter and Instagram to keep up to date with more news and curiosities from behind the scenes...

Cheers from Team Somnia, and thanks for your support!

Tobías and Andrés

notes.title: DEMO, SHOOTING SESSIONS, EVENTS AND MORE 🏆
notes.content:
Big news for Tenebris Somnia!

Incredible things have been going on with the project since our last post we made last year.

We released a demo together with a new trailer, which went viral on Twitter! We did the first definitive shooting sessions for the cinematics of the game. And we also won the biggest prize a game can get in our country!

We’ll tell you everything about that and much more in this post.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/9194b1759dc0f823e44971410a13a89971a94e81.png

 New logo designed by Claudio ”Scuzzo” Sagrera


THE SHOOTING SESSIONS

To start off, at the beginning of 2023 we got a Mega Grant from Epic Games. This has helped us a lot to keep working on the project without needing to use our savings 💸

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/0734720d13e0aeabb385d962e3b6f6f4c3a66339.jpg

 Picture: Clara Kovacic as “Julia”


Thanks to this support, during the months of April and May we were able to shoot the first definitive sessions for the movies of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/3cc9f5aa839c91f1cfb782ddcd38925a47e4dc66.jpg

 Andrés Borghi (game director) and Matías Rispau (director of photography and camera)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/b2e986913d0337b42754d4fe359f41d68d924df7.jpg

 First monster’s mask created by Marcos Berta Studio


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/b775db1b8dfa7d0d66b9659b2e93bde0c6fac539.jpg

 Hugo Caceres, Juan Lopez, Andrés Borghi, Matías Rispau, Amanda Nara and Juli Quiroga


They were three intense (but super fun) working days with a lot of movie professionals, including actors, scenography, make-up, special effects, cameras, lighting, among others.

And right now, we’re preparing the second part of the definitive film sessions for the end of the year, where we’re looking to complete a very important part of the story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/34eba9092f9534d408c4a8db7657bfc51ff5c0fc.jpg

 Picture by Juan Lopez. Left to right: Matías Rispau, Marcos Berta, Flor Fiori and Andrés Borghi


THE DEV TEAM

In terms of the game itself, we continue working with the unmatched team of graphic artists: El Toreh as concept artist and illustrator, Attar doing most of the pixel art and Pedrito Caval in pixel art and animations for characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/e52b31901f87c96403dcec1b9192e0fdf6ef2e39.jpg

 Left to right: El Toreh, Attar, Pedrito Caval, Andrés Borghi y Tobías Rusjan


But this time, a well know friend of us joined the team: David Levill, the music producer and sound designer from our games Doorways, Hellbound and Out of Bounds; and the guy who did the remaster of The Black Heart soundtrack.

For Tenebris Somnia, David is doing the music and sound effects for the 8-bit version 👾

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/0bd848840133477db53b9c35c54d5e167873d590.jpg

 David Levill at his studio in Santa Cruz, Río Gallegos (Argentina)



PLAYABLE DEMO

This month of September 2023 was without a doubt the most important month for Tenebris Somnia to date.

After working for more than a year on the project, both in development and making the movies, we finally launched a playable demo of the game so everybody can taste a small bit of what this dark and twisted survival horror adventure is all about.

Didn’t try the demo yet? Go to the next link and find the big green button to start the download 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/

Since the release of the demo, we have been reading and listening to every opinion and feedback you gave us. Even though the reception was great in general, there were some things to fix and improve. So we have made a quick update to the demo including some changes based on your feedback. You can find the full list on the bottom of this post 🗒️

Don’t stop letting us know about what you think! You can use the Steam discussion section for that.


FEAR FEST AND TRAILER

We launched the demo together with a new trailer which was broadcasted for the first time at the event Fear Fest: Black Summer 2023 hosted by Feardemic and featured at the IGN official channels. The new trailer is short, but super intense, and shows new characters, locations, mechanics and (above everything) a lot of horror:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/2b3fc6bb91993d8512dc3b3145c7bee85696e64c.jpg

 Watch the trailer. Picture: María Eugenia Rigon as “Vitria”


During the event, there was also a special interview with the game director Andrés Borghi. You can watch it in the link below:

https://youtu.be/3FNLzRIgx6E?si=sBy3Wb9EYpLgptmp


Both the demo and the trailer traveled through the internet all around the world. From the dev team, we were shocked with the impact and reception the game had. The news came out on big sites like 
PC Gamer, RPS, Vandal, Meristation and Bloody Disgusting; but the demo was also played by big influencers from different parts of globe 🤯


EVA AND RECOGNITION

A week after the big announcement, we participated in the most important local event of game development here in Argentina: EVA 2023. We were there with the team presenting an extended version of the demo of Tenebris Somnia so people from our country could check the new mechanics and cinematics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/a4bc720c7d17f5504ffd3bb5ece65a86355c7db2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/6929d3a5bd47813b34e778e595e8d7d437a6c3f4.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/861368215d9ccf15bc93b2fd657ca332324ccc44.jpg

 See more pictures from the event


The feedback was great once again. And thanks to the people who visited our stand, we were able to fix and improve different things for the game.

And to close this lovely month of ”Septembris”, the game won the prise Best Game EVA 2023, the biggest award of the event. 🏆

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/f383e617eedbfe7055f726a977fb23b194b25cb5.gif

 Animation created by Attar


REALMS DEEP

And speaking of events, we’re right now participating for the second consecutive years in the online event Realms Deep 2023, hosted by the guys at 3D Realms 🙌

Don’t miss all the sales of great indie games with retro vibes! Also, tomorrow (Saturday 30th), a broadcast will start with announcements of new titles and interviews to the developers. Check everything here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/0c80d5890fcb6a83692a42f8c151bfb6d5900189.png

To finish, we want to share with you how happy we are right now with everything that has been going on with Tenebris Somnia. There’s still a lot to do, but we have all the motivation in the world right now. Thank you for that!

Below are some new screenshots from the game and on the very bottom of this post is the changelog of the demo update. Don’t forget to leave your feedback!

A big hug from the team! Thank you once again for all the support and stay tunned for more news and behind the scenes material at our accounts in Twitter and Instagram 👌

Cheers, everybody!

Tobías and Andrés


NEW SCREENSHOTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/00b957abc0d58cee6f8179bde8ac772395776f5d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/91ca7b0818aaae1dec7d71559d7d86a0794d3969.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/03f7ae824c0f19ea05bd81e6685caa07fda19e38.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/bf7c250cbd1adcc992b947253d2ec2410ee69932.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/8a5052b2ae43013eaab9bf4b0bc94a3bd427585a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/feb8ebc3027d16e1bc20d4c788497a927e5ef671.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/72548f548fc41edeb9a34b1215a975be9bf643a4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/48a2e4d4b03a5af07275aeb639611e4791ce0293.png


DEMO CHANGELOG (v0.2)

Bug fixes


 Sometimes, opening the inventory or re-entering a room during a fade transition blocked the game

 Some texts went out of the screen in 16x10 monitors, including the Steam Deck

 Fixed the vertical synchronization (VSync) issue

General improvements


 Added blood particles when afflicting damage and when receiving it

 New sound effects for certain steps, elevator door, oven, among others

 Visual improvements for some of the props of the environment

 Added a one time language menu option when the application starts

 Besides skipping the text screens and movies using the action key, there was a skip-all shortcut that was barely used. We removed that key now.

 During the confrontation with the first enemy, now you can interact with any part of the environment, including doors to avoid it

 Improved some of the texts from dialogues and interface, mostly in the English version

 Now, the options can be selected like a carousel, moving to the sides left or right

 Added a new set of controls combining the mouse and the keyboard (see image)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/35bce83f89db44c3578ac00ac50fdfb5bcf59e6e.png

notes.title: 🚨 New game Out of Bounds is NOW AVAILABLE! 🚨
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! How have you been?

We're doing PRETTY WELL! Closing this crazy 2022 celebrating 🥳

And that's not only because our football team won the World Cup, but also because we have just released a new game on Steam:

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png

Out of Bounds is a peculiar title that was originally created for a game jam the past year (Epic Megajam 2021). As a solo dev, I had 7 days to create a game that was later released for free on Itchio.

Since I liked the result of the jam, I decided to keep working on that idea for the next months and also some great devs (former colleagues from other projects) joined me to get the best results in visuals (Viktor Ahmed and Claudio "Scuzzo" Sagrera) and audio (David Levill) 🙌



THE GAME

Out of Bounds is a title about "creating" a game and "fixing" bugs... Yeah, it's crazy. You will pickup blueprints, compile shaders, test sound effects, drink a lot of coffee. But watch out for the bugs! Grab your Line Tracer and get rid of them 👾

https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg
Things are starting to get better here in Saibot Studios and Out of Bounds is part of that process. I'm looking forward to bring you news about bigger projects in the future, but for now give a chance to this crazy puzzle shooter with humor and puzzles 🤓

You can follow Out of Bounds on its new Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg



NEWS ABOUT EXPLOSIONS AND GORE?

Hell yeah! The people at Humble Bundle created a new package of retro style first person shooters based on the one they did in March of this year 🔥

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d71afde69b8306dbbb108c8e6fbcb9e42f3a60d0.png

This time, you can get 7 awesome titles for only 12 dollars, including our own Hellbound and the great Forgive Me Father was also added to the list.

A percentage of the sales will go to charity at Able Gamers and Starlight Children's Foundation ❤️

Hurry up! Get the bundle before the next 24 hours ⏲️



If you have a Twitter account, don't forget to follow us for more news:
https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios

Cheers and take care!

Tobías

notes.title: 📦 COLLECTION + SPECIAL VIDEO + MORE! 🪙
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/2baf71e0692653c469784f5518da8d0bd44810da.png


Hello there! How are you? How's your 2022 so far? 😎

From here, we have a few things to tell you...

As we mentioned you in our last post, this year we reached an entire decade since we started making games as an independent team in Saibot Studios. But it was just now that we actually make something special to celebrate it. Check out the special video!

https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo

Together with this video, we built and launched a collection with all our published games, including: the Doorways saga, Hellbound and The Black Heart 😈

> LINK TO BUNDLE <

Buying the games from the bundle, gives you a 15% of discount on all the titles. And if you already have one or more of the games included in the package, it will discount you the titles you're missing without needing to buy the entire bundle 👌



TENEBRIS SOMNIA

On the other hand, we receently announced our new creation: Tenebris Somnia. This is a very unique title by the great Andrés Borghi, creator of The Black Heart 🖤

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3dc732cee7c111bb33503e507a649dcf3d66ae79.png

We're developing this project Andrés and I (Tobías Rusjan), together with a great team of artists. You can read more about it and the dev team in this other post we did the past week.

If you like the concept of the game, don't forget to add it to your Wishlists. We're aiming to have it ready during 2023 👍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/



OUT OF BOUNDS

In the mean time, I keep working on my little jam game Out of Bounds, a rare title with action, shooting and puzzles. We released a demo in June and it's still available to check directly from the store page:

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png

My idea is finish the full game for the end of the year. So play the demo and add it to your wishlist if you liked it! 🙌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/



HELLBOUND... HELLBOUND?

This month we received the great news from our (now) former publishers that they're giving us back the IP of Hellbound 🤯

What does this mean?

Finally, we at Saibot Studios are going to start receiving sales from Hellbound on Steam. Since the release of 2020, all the sales went to the publisher because that was what we stablished: they recoup their investment first, and then we split; but we never reached that last step because they never recoup their part with the sales we had.

But now after two years from the release, they're giving us back the game so we can atleast see some of the sales. Also, we got back the full rights of the project to take any desision we want from now on 🔥

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/5d56edecbe4128de8d9912896496161a814e16f3.png

In March of this year there was the Best of Boomer Shooters Bundle, the first collection of Humble Bundle focused on retro FPSs. Hellbound had the honour to be included in that package, becoming the first argentinian game in participate in the iconic Humble Bundle:

https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM

Both the sales from this collection and also the sales from now on (September of 2022) at Steam are going to us at Saibot. Yes, finally!

But unfortunately, this aren't earnings for us yet, since we still need to recoup all we put to create the Hellbound: Survival Mode in 2016-2018.

So the future of Hellbound is still uncertain... The good thing is that everything has started looking brighter now, we'll see how things turn for our Hellgore in the next months 🤞



That would be all for now, people. Hope we have some more news for you soon, follow us in our networks to stay updated:

 Twitter 
 Instagram 
 Facebook
 You Tube


Cheers, everybody! Take care!

Tobias

notes.title: WELCOME 👁️
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here are Andrés Borghi (creative director and screenplay) and Tobías Rusjan (project director and programmer) ✊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/1a241f23e210b9ac7226612f5ed5eb40da5d3951.jpg
Tobías (left) and Andrés (right). Picture by Voltaire Musso Rovitti


Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror in the vein of old-school classic Resident Evil and Silent Hill games, but set in a 2D environment, with pixel art 8-bit visuals 👾

The distinctive feature that makes Tenebris Somnia stand out from other games is the cutscenes. As you progress in the game, you will come across movies filmed with live-action actors in a real life set. This creates a huge contrast of styles never seen before, increasing the sense of strangeness and terror…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/a8e62a65e980c31f4f503932469371d15e7c6d46.png
Watch the teaser trailer on YouTube. Actress: Clara Kovacic


The Tenebris Somnia project is an idea by Andrés developed together with Tobías and a great team of artists: Attar (main pixel artist), El Toreh (concept artist) and Pedro Caval (character animator) 🙌

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/a50a2b9c97156d24e1169b656aec60d98b1109b2.jpg
Left to right: El Toreh, Andrés, Attar, Pedro and Tobías


The past week was the EVA 2022, the biggest annual event about game development here in Argentina. During the event, we showcased a very early version of the game for the first time so people who attended the expo could play it 🕹

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/056aa45e7c84ac128523caf5817d0fff1d447c8d.jpg


The reception of the game was EXCELLENT! Thanks to you, we know what to fix and improve in order to reach the best game results 👌

But this has just begun! There’s still a lot of work to do and right now we’re looking for fundings and publishers interested in helping us out to make the full project a reality.

In the meantime, we’ll continue working and keep you updated on our social networks. Follow us!

 Tenebris Somnia official Twitter
 Andrés Borghi on Instagram
 Saibot Studios on Facebook
 Saibot Studios on Instagram



Before leaving, here are some screenshots of the game:
